Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5078-6918-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3800-4687-6723.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3800-4687-6723.description:
Activate A Realm Reborn by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

You are able to play a land this turn.

Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

719-2366-6879-8095.easyPrerequisites:

"[Type]" chosen with Xenograft.

Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.

When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

708-728-2459-4948.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation.
Repeat.

240-4247-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2099-5131-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

586-864-2292-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-7396.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2738-4871-6248-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-2728-5147-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5147-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5147-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2122-7811-7824.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Iron Man triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

1008-1619-4605-5542-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5542-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5542-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

851-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

206-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3967-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-5075-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

413-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
413-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

204-1858-2056-2633-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-7175.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

141-780-3967.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-5006-6798--23.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-5006-6798--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1
Repeat.

1021-2034-5226-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-2034-5226-6761.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-2034-5226-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

647-1563-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

856-2267-2981-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2103-4823-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Timeless Witness each turn.
2103-4823-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

573-1479-2719.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Eldrazi Creature Card with MV=4, 5 or 6

5473-5637-5657--34.manaNeeded: {C}{C} plus enough mana to pay for the Eldrazi spell
5473-5637-5657--34.description:
Cast an Eldrazi with mana value 4, 5 or 6 from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Ulalek triggers twice, and Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers once. The Eldrazi cast also triggers if it has a cast ability.
Resolve the first Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, Kozilek's Unsealing's trigger, and the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one.
Resolve the Eldrazi cast trigger, if applicable.
Resolve the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate the two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, Kozilek's Unsealing's trigger, and the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one.
Repeat from step 4.
5473-5637-5657--34.notes: This combo will result in infinite copies of the cast Eldrazi, thus resulting in infinite creature tokens.  You may also forego the resolution of Kozliek's Unsealing's trigger on the first iteration, requiring an additional {C}{C}, but giving you additional triggers to then get infinite Eldrazi Spawns.

1008-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer does not have summoning sickness.
1008-1909-4486.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat.
1008-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

4734-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Cradle Clearcutter
4734-5200.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Cradle Clearcutter
Repeat.
4734-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

586-4050-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-4050-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding one mana of any color.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

864-1170-4923.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard that has legal targets and that can be cast using {B}{B}{B}.
You have at least eight or more cards in your graveyard.
864-1170-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

759-1984-4281-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, causing you to be unable to lose the game this turn.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Grollub and reduing your lifetotal to one due to Angel's Grace.
Grollub triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt to it due to Tainted Remedy.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2724-3217-4243.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Venser, the Sojourner. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

11-2160-4406-5261.description:
Cast Chance for Glory.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal, copying Chance for Glory and returning Chance for Glory to your hand.
Move to your extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 and 2.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory's lose the game trigger goes onto the stack.
Holding priority, tap Sundial of the Infinite, ending the turn and exiling the trigger.
Repeat steps 3-6.

1722-3410-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1722-3410-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {U/B}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
